recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the accepted clarification across the relevant case-insensitive search and sort sections without changing search semantics beyond documenting implementation-dependent locale behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-38688 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested guidance that character case definitions and conversions are out of scope for FHIR, making case-insensitive text searching and sorting behavior implementation dependent across locales.
initial_application: Git commit f4141be15d0815858d609ebdb4b463f9b23c7dd7 added locale warning prose to source/search.html for code-text, contains, exact, and the base string search type. Current source retained that application, but the Jira-related text, text-advanced, and sorting sections still lacked the warning, and exact retained a warning that did not apply to exact matching.
additional_context: source/search.html is the authoritative source for the build.fhir.org search page named in the Jira. FHIR-I minutes on 2022-11-28 corroborate the 12-0-0 persuasive vote; 2022-11-21 minutes show the issue was deferred to that vote. Later search-page cleanup did not add the missing locale guidance.
reconciliation: Published a source fix adding the locale/implementation-dependent warning to the text modifier, text-advanced modifier, and string sorting paragraphs, while removing the misplaced case-insensitive warning from exact matching.
source_changes: source/search.html: removed the case-insensitive locale warning from the exact modifier because exact matching includes casing.
source/search.html: added the locale/implementation-dependent warning to the reference/token text modifier's basic case-insensitive string matching paragraph.
source/search.html: added the locale/implementation-dependent warning to text-advanced when case-insensitive comparisons are performed.
source/search.html: added the implementation-dependent character case warning to case-insensitive string sorting.
